paragraphs.text:
Abruptly, the attack upon your will ceases. You hear the hag 
gasp, and she collapses on the earth behind you. The chanting 
stops. A hush spreads through the camp. They break from the 
ring and gather over the old woman.

In  some  distress,  the  Keywanema  confer.  After  a  few 
minutes, they gather up their unconscious queen and carry her 
away. They leave you and the students still bound.
